# Commently

> Self-hosted comments-as-a-service. Add threaded, context-anchored comments to any application.

Commently is an open-source, multi-tenant REST API that provides generic commenting functionality. It is resource-agnostic — it stores comments against opaque identifiers that your application defines. One Commently instance can serve multiple applications, each isolated by API key.

## Key Features

- Multi-tenant: each consuming app gets its own API key with full data isolation
- Resource-agnostic: comments attach to any string identifier (resource_id)
- Context-anchored: optional sub-location anchoring via context_key (e.g. slide:3, paragraph:12)
- Threaded: one level of replies via parent_id
- Emoji reactions: per-comment reactions with grouped counts
- Comment editing: time-windowed editing (default 15 minutes, author-only)
- Webhooks: HTTP notifications on comment.created and comment.deleted with HMAC signing
- Bulk export: export comments per resource or per tenant
- Soft deletes: deleted comments are excluded from queries but preserved in the database

## Tech Stack

- Runtime: Node.js + Express
- Database: PostgreSQL (raw SQL, no ORM)
- Auth: API key per tenant (SHA-256 hashed), admin key for management
- Deployment: Render.com (web service + PostgreSQL + static site)

## API Endpoints

### Admin (Authorization: Bearer header)
- POST /api/tenants — create tenant
- GET /api/tenants — list tenants
- GET /api/tenants/:id/stats — tenant statistics
- POST /api/tenants/:id/rotate-key — rotate API key
- DELETE /api/tenants/:id — delete tenant and all data
- GET /api/export/tenant/:id — export all tenant comments

### Tenant (X-API-Key header)
- POST /api/comments — create comment
- GET /api/comments — list comments (cursor pagination)
- GET /api/comments/counts — comment counts (grouped or batch)
- PATCH /api/comments/:id — edit comment
- DELETE /api/comments/:id — soft-delete comment
- POST /api/comments/:id/reactions — add emoji reaction
- GET /api/comments/:id/reactions — list reactions
- DELETE /api/comments/:id/reactions — remove reaction
- POST /api/webhooks — register webhook
- GET /api/webhooks — list webhooks
- DELETE /api/webhooks/:id — delete webhook
- GET /api/export/resource — export resource comments
